title: DTF Terpene Atlas laboratory/sample profile

fields.displayName: cultivar or sample label exactly as source reported
fields.cultivarName: normalized cultivar name when known; nullable
fields.source: lab report, publication or dataset citation
fields.method: GC-MS, GC-FID or other reported analytical method
fields.measurements: array of measurement records; each record must include compoundId or a source-reported analyte name plus value/range/qualifier and any detection/quantitation metadata

measurementIdentity.compoundId: preferred Atlas stable id when already known
measurementIdentity.reportedName: source/laboratory analyte name exactly as reported; preserved even when normalization succeeds
measurementIdentity.analyte: accepted alternate input key for reportedName
measurementIdentity.name: accepted alternate input key for reportedName
measurementIdentity.compoundName: accepted alternate input key for reportedName
measurementIdentity.identityResolution: runtime result: resolved | partial | unresolved; generated by Atlas normalization and not required from source files

rules: A cultivar name is not a measurement.
Never infer a percentage from another sample carrying the same strain name.
Retain below-LOD, below-LOQ and not-tested states distinctly from zero.
All measurements must identify their unit and source.
A measurement may provide an Atlas compoundId or the source-reported analyte name; the Atlas must preserve the original label.
Do not infer stereochemistry that the laboratory or publication did not report.
